problems: every world in the region: ~513 KiB/s down a single socket for one parked player (14.0/screen). Their measurement puts the cost at ~920 B/s per creature in the active neighbourhood, so this is a bandwidth decision rather than a flavour one. Two levers, and the biomes are neither: target_per_screen of 11 or below lands on `dense` (8.1/screen), or keep the density and halve chunk_size - the neighbourhood is 9 chunks, so the cost falls with the SQUARE of it (32 -> 16 is ~4x less).
notes: Creature counts are scatter only; packs are not modelled, so every figure is a floor. See PACKS_NOT_MODELLED.
One screen is ~225 tiles at something2's fixed 1280x720 canvas.

problems: every world in the region: ~513 KiB/s down a single socket for one parked player (14.0/screen). Their measurement puts the cost at ~920 B/s per creature in the active neighbourhood, so this is a bandwidth decision rather than a flavour one. Two levers, and the biomes are neither: target_per_screen of 11 or below lands on `dense` (8.1/screen), or keep the density and halve chunk_size - the neighbourhood is 9 chunks, so the cost falls with the SQUARE of it (32 -> 16 is ~4x less).
notes: Creature counts are scatter only; packs are not modelled, so every figure is a floor. See PACKS_NOT_MODELLED.
One screen is ~225 tiles at something2's fixed 1280x720 canvas.
